title: Grounds maintenance for a Keating business park

seo.title: Sample project: Keating business park grounds | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: grounds care for a Keating business park in Central Saanich, done before tenant hours, with issues reported in writing.

summary: Scheduled frontage, boulevard-edge and parking-island care for a multi-tenant business park.
scope: Parking island bed care and mulch
Issue reports to the property manager
challenge: The property manager needed grounds work done before tenants' trucks filled the lot each morning.
approach: We scheduled early-morning visits and kept a short checklist for each area: frontage lawns, parking islands and litter pick-up.
When we found a damaged sprinkler line and a dying shrub row, we reported both in writing with photos and waited for a decision.
result: Work finished around tenant hours, with issues reported in writing.
